hitbox.basis: Acquired by US rival Azubu in 2017 (merged into Smashcast, shut 2020; Hitbox Entertainment GmbH Vienna insolvent 2023). Speedinvest on board since a 2014 $1M round that no page names, then led the 2015 $4M round. https://www.trendingtopics.eu/hitbox-speedinvest-fuehrt-4-millionen-dollar-investmentrunde-in-das-wiener-gaming-start-up-an/ https://www.trendingtopics.eu/hitbox-einst-fuer-den-exit-gefeiert-jetzt-im-konkurs/

stowga.basis: Speedinvest co-led the GBP 1.5M seed round of Dec 2017 (https://tech.eu/brief/stowga-funding, https://www.logisticsmatters.co.uk/product/stowga-raises-investment-money/); no later round found, stowga.com no longer resolves (last Wayback capture Dec 2023) and no Stowga company is on the Companies House register under that name.

maqsad.basis: Speedinvest led the $2.8M seed round of March 2023 as an incoming investor (the Sept 2021 pre-seed was led by Indus Valley Capital without it); no Series A found, the site is live with a Karachi address. https://www.menabytes.com/maqsad-seed/ https://techcrunch.com/2021/09/19/pakistan-edtech-startup-maqsad-gets-2-1-m-pre-seed-to-make-education-more-accessible/ https://maqsad.io/

abhi.basis: Speedinvest led the $17M Series A of April 2022; the 2021 seed was raised without it. Site live, Karachi office. https://www.arabnews.com/node/2066416/business-economy https://www.menabytes.com/abhi-seed-yc/ https://abhi.com.pk/

tier.basis: Speedinvest and Point Nine were existing investors when Northzone led the EUR 25M Series A of Oct 2018 (https://techcrunch.com/2018/10/23/tier-scooters/); the earlier round is titled a seed by PwC Legal (https://legal.pwc.de/en/news/press-releases/pwc-legal-advises-tier-mobility-on-seed-and-subsequent-series-a-financing-round-of-approx-eur-27m, title seen in search results, body did not load). Merged with Dott in 2024: Tier Mobility SE in Berlin is the surviving entity, trading as Dott, so it was not sold to a third party; the 2021 $2B mark collapsed, with the merged company valued at about EUR 150M (https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2024/01/10/dealmonitor-tier-sunvigo-airfocus/, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dott_(transportation_company)). Speedinvest's own page calls it exited by merger (https://www.speedinvest.com/portfolio/tier), so acquired is the alternative reading.

wefox.basis: Speedinvest joined the $5.5M round of Jan 2016 led by Salesforce Ventures (unnamed by TechCrunch; Trending Topics says the Speedinvest partner worked with wefox in its seed stage) and was an existing investor in the $28M Series A of Sept 2016. The $4.5B mark collapsed: new money in Dec 2024 at a roughly 90% markdown, and the company left Germany. Imprint: wefox Holding AG, Zurich. https://techcrunch.com/2016/01/12/financefox/ https://techcrunch.com/2016/09/20/european-insurance-tech-startup-financefox-closes-28m-series-a/ https://www.trendingtopics.eu/helu-wiener-fintech-holt-frische-98-millionen-euro-in-der-series-a/ https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2024/12/11/startupticker-desknow-wefox-debtist/ https://www.wefox.com/imprint

daslab.basis: Speedinvest led the EUR 6.2M seed of March 2022 (https://tech.eu/2022/03/02/aiming-to-unite-a-fragmented-medical-diagnostics-testing-industry-daslab-raises-eur62-million/). Das Lab GmbH moved its seat from Berlin to Munich in 2023; the Munich court opened insolvency proceedings in Jan 2025 and both it and its holding Advanced Diagnostics GmbH are in liquidation, no sale found (https://www.northdata.com/Das%20Lab%20GmbH,%20M%C3%BCnchen/HRB%20285719).

helu-io.basis: The July 2021 seed lists Atlantic Labs and angels, not Speedinvest; Speedinvest is first named in the EUR 9.8M Series A of July 2022 led by CommerzVentures. Site live, Vienna address. https://www.trendingtopics.eu/helu-neues-wiener-startup-holt-42-mio-euro-unter-anderem-von-bitpanda-ceo/ https://www.trendingtopics.eu/helu-wiener-fintech-holt-frische-98-millionen-euro-in-der-series-a/ https://tech.eu/2022/07/29/simplifying-financial-processes-for-smes-vienna-based-platform-helu-picks-up-eur98-million/ https://www.helu.io/

oz.basis: Speedinvest led the $3M round of Jan 2022 that TechCrunch names pre-Series A, after a $700K seed raised without it; read as a seed-stage round, and no round named Series A has followed. Site live, Accra head office. https://techcrunch.com/2022/01/25/ghanas-oze-gets-3m-to-scale-its-digital-recordkeeping-and-embedded-finance-products/ https://getoze.com/

wegfinder.basis: Started around 2015 as iMobility GmbH, a joint venture of Speedinvest and ÖBB with no named round; the register shows Speedinvest II leaving as shareholder in Sept 2017 with ÖBB-Holding taking over, and the app still runs as an ÖBB company. https://www.trendingtopics.eu/wegfinder-wiener-navigations-app-verkauft-jetzt-tickets-von-oebb-und-oeffis/ https://www.northdata.com/iMobility%20GmbH,%20Wien/434586y https://wegfinder.at/

myclubs.basis: Sold to Urban Sports Club in Aug 2024 for a reported two-digit million euro amount. Speedinvest is first named as a new investor in the Sept 2017 round, described only as an investment in the millions, so the round has no name. https://www.trendingtopics.eu/myclubs-exit-wiener-fitness-scale-up-verkauft-an-deutschen-mitbewerber-urban-sports-club/ https://www.trendingtopics.eu/myclubs-mysugr-gruender-investieren-beim-wiener-fitnesscenter-aggregator/ https://www.speedinvest.com/portfolio/myclubs

billie.basis: Speedinvest was among the founding backers of the first EUR 3.5M (reported Feb 2017, Speedinvest lists 2016) and an existing investor in the EUR 10M round of Dec 2017; no page I loaded names that first round. Last priced round: $100M Series C at a $640M valuation, Oct 2021. https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2017/02/28/35-millionen-flossen-bereits-ins-factoring-startup-billie/ https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2017/12/07/creandum-investiert-10-millionen-factoringdienst/ https://www.billie.io/en/press/billie-funding-round-series-c

upvest.basis: Speedinvest lists 2017 as its investment year, before any named round; the earliest named round with Speedinvest is the EUR 7M Series A of 2019 (Notion, HV, Partech), so Series A is the fallback reading. Series C of EUR 100M (Dec 2024) and $125M (Mar 2026) came with no disclosed valuation. https://www.speedinvest.com/portfolio/upvest https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2020/12/10/dealmonitor-10-12-2020/ https://upvest.co/blog/upvest-closes-eu12m-series-a-with-additional-financing-from-earlybird-to-offer-the-first-european-securities-api-for-fintechs https://tech.eu/2026/03/17/upvest-raises-125m-to-strengthen-its-api-based-investment-platform/

aucobo.basis: Speedinvest and 10x invested a seven-digit sum in July 2019; the article gives the round no name. aucobo GmbH is active in Stuttgart, with new managing directors since March 2025 and no insolvency or merger entry. https://www.eu-startups.com/2019/07/stuttgart-based-industrial-wearable-startup-aucobo-raises-seven-digit-sum-from-speedinvest/ (read via web.archive.org) https://www.northdata.com/aucobo%20GmbH,%20Stuttgart/Amtsgericht%20Mannheim%20HRB%20725452 https://www.aucobo.com/impressum

moyai.basis: The company's about page lists Speedinvest, Galion.exe and AI Angels on the cap table without naming a round; LinkedIn gives Amsterdam, founded 2024. A PitchBook search snippet (page not loadable) labels a seed round in Jan 2025, which would make it Seed and censored. https://moyai.ai/about/ https://www.linkedin.com/company/moyai-ai/

yolda.basis: Speedinvest led the $1.9M seed of June 2021 and joined the $5M bridge of Dec 2021; no Series A followed. Murat Lojistik acquired Yolda's software, brand and rights, and yolda.com now redirects to it. https://tech.eu/2021/06/10/istanbul-based-logistics-startup-yolda-raises-1-9-million-applies-sharing-economy-principles-to-freight-forwarding/ https://tech.eu/2021/12/13/yolda-keeps-on-trucking-with-5-million-bridge-round/ https://www.linkedin.com/company/yoldacom/ https://www.muratlojistik.com.tr/

raus.basis: Speedinvest led the low seven-digit seed of July 2021; the EUR 8.5M round of Nov 2023 (Roch, Rockaway, with Speedinvest following) is not named Series A in the pages read. StayRaus GmbH, Berlin, is operating. https://www.eu-startups.com/2021/07/berlin-based-hospitality-startup-raus-secures-seed-funding-to-reinvent-nature-hospitality/ and https://www.eu-startups.com/2023/11/berlin-based-raus-snaps-e8-5-million-to-supercharge-its-nature-immersion-platform/ (both read via web.archive.org) https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2023/11/09/dealmonitor-raus-doctorly/ https://raus.life/imprint

flank.basis: Formerly Legal OS. Speedinvest was already an existing backer (it lists 2018) when HV led the seed of June 2019, so its first round predates the seed and no page names it; Seed is the earliest named round it took part in. $10M from Insight Partners in June 2025. https://tech.eu/2019/06/19/berlin-based-legal-tech-startup-legal-os-secures-2-2-million-in-seed-funding/ https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2025/06/06/dealmonitor-flank-froots-doctorly/ https://www.speedinvest.com/portfolio/flank

complyance.basis: Speedinvest lists 2022 as its investment year and is an existing investor in the $20M Series A led by GV (Feb 2026, $28M raised in total); no page names the earlier round. LinkedIn gives New York as headquarters, while the contracting entity is Securely Technology Limited, London, so GB/London is the alternative. https://www.complyance.com/resources/complyance-raises-20m https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/11/complyance-raises-20m-to-help-companies-manage-risk-and-compliance/ https://www.linkedin.com/company/complyancehq https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/14257604
